lumexTutoringCenter.title: Lumex Tutoring Center Management System
lumexTutoringCenter.shortDesc: A comprehensive platform developed for educational institutions with student tracking, class schedule management and exam result analysis.
lumexTutoringCenter.fullDesc: A modern management panel designed for the digital transformation of educational centers. Developed using Next.js App Router architecture and TiDB Cloud database infrastructure. The system consolidates critical processes such as class scheduling, assignment distribution and submission processes, instant messaging, attendance tracking and exam result reporting in a single platform.
features: Class schedule and weekly schedule management
Assignment distribution, submission and feedback system
Advanced exam result analytics and reporting
Secure cloud database integration with TiDB Cloud
Modern UI/UX Design and Mobile Compatibility

universityCommunitySystem.title: University Community Information System
universityCommunitySystem.shortDesc: A comprehensive management and event platform developed for university student communities with 4 different authorization levels.
universityCommunitySystem.fullDesc: A modern community information system that digitizes campus life and accelerates processes. Fully developed using Next.js App Router architecture. The system features four different management panels specially designed for standard students, community management boards, academic advisors and SKS administrative personnel. All processes such as event applications, member approvals and institutional memory are managed hierarchically.
features: 4 Different User Roles and Role-Specific Dashboard Screens
Hierarchical Event and Document Approval Mechanism
Dynamic Member and Management Board Role Control
Institutional Memory (Past Approvals/Rejections and Report Archive)
Interactive Event Calendar and Announcement Management
Advanced UI/UX (Tailwind CSS v4 & Lucide Icons)

gymAppointmentSystem.title: Gym Appointment And Management System
gymAppointmentSystem.shortDesc: Fully integrated member management for fitness studios, personal trainer appointments and online payment infrastructure.
gymAppointmentSystem.fullDesc: A comprehensive management platform designed for modern fitness studios. It includes member registration and tracking system, personal trainer appointment management, online payment infrastructure, nutrition program tracking and performance analytics.
features: Member Management System and Profile Tracking

realEstateCarSales.title: Real Estate And Car Sales Platform
realEstateCarSales.shortDesc: Real Estate and Vehicle Buying-Selling Platform with Advanced Filtering and Secure Messaging System.
realEstateCarSales.fullDesc: A Two-Sided Marketplace Platform Designed for Both Real Estate and Vehicle Sales. It Features an Advanced Filtering System, Location-Based Search and Real-Time Messaging Between Users.

smartProgramSystem.title: Smart Program System
smartProgramSystem.shortDesc: An Intelligent Program Management And Automation System For Streamlining Complex Business Processes.
smartProgramSystem.fullDesc: The Smart Program System Is An Intelligent Solution Designed To Automate And Optimize Complex Business Workflows. This System Provides Intelligent Scheduling, Resource Management, And Performance Analytics To Help Organizations Achieve Their Goals More Efficiently.

solfej.title: Solfej.net - Music Platform
solfej.shortDesc: A modern music platform offering a rich archive of Turkish folk music and interactive sheet music.
solfej.fullDesc: Solfej.net is a modern and interactive music platform specially developed for Turkish folk music enthusiasts. Users can listen to their favorite folk songs in high quality, access extensive sheet music archives, and benefit from a rich content library. With a customized dark mode interface and dynamic features, it offers users a unique musical experience.
